The '''Hutt Flats''', also known as '''Grand Arena Flats''', was the last segment of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]]. Thousands of years prior, it was the bed of prehistoric [[Lake Anre/Legends|Lake Anre]], which, via underground tributaries, flowed into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

==History==
[[File:Boonta_final_lap.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Podrace in the Hutt Flats.]]

During the race of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] pod was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the Hutt Flats. At this part of the Boonta Eve Classic the podracer [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]] vanished.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
